purpose: Sign-leg and Ricci-flat scope audit for fixed positive-mirror mixed rows as candidate P_4^+ refutation targets.

einstein_4d_chern_weil_formula.assumption: Ric = lambda*g on a closed oriented 4-manifold; s=4*lambda
einstein_4d_chern_weil_formula.sign_note: The formula depends on lambda^2. Positive and negative Einstein constants have the same Chern-Weil budgets after fixing |lambda|; negative lambda does NOT reverse the scalar term sign.

ricci_flat_special_holonomy_exclusion.flat_holonomy: excluded by chi=8 (flat compact manifolds have chi=0, and row is simply connected)
ricci_flat_special_holonomy_exclusion.reducible_holonomy: excluded: compact simply connected Ricci-flat factors in dimensions 1,2,3 are flat/nonexistent, so a reducible 4D product cannot realize chi=8
ricci_flat_special_holonomy_exclusion.SU2_hyperkahler: excluded by K3 topological invariants: compact simply connected hyperkahler surface has K3 type with chi=24, tau=-16 up to orientation
ricci_flat_special_holonomy_exclusion.generic_SO4: NOT excluded by known classification; existence of compact irreducible Ricci-flat metrics with generic SO(n) holonomy is an open problem in dimension >=4

fixed_row_refutation_logic.construction_leg: available under recorded log-Weyl/EH hypotheses: near-positive Ricci-pinched metrics with defect O(1/|log a|) on each fixed A1 filling pattern
fixed_row_refutation_logic.nonexistence_leg: must exclude Einstein metrics for lambda>0, lambda=0, and lambda<0 on the same smooth row
fixed_row_refutation_logic.lambda_positive: alignment/Gram/T-anisotropy could only target this sign because the harmonic SD Weitzenbock lower term is s/6>0; current crude and CLR chains do not close
fixed_row_refutation_logic.lambda_zero: special-holonomy Ricci-flat cases are excluded by chi/pi1, but generic irreducible SO(4) holonomy is not classified; therefore not banked as a theorem
fixed_row_refutation_logic.lambda_negative: no current PSC-compatible obstruction; monopole/Bauer-Furuta routes require inputs absent on the mixed rows and alignment is sign-locked to s>0

source_anchors: Degen K3 moduli note lines 27-29: classification of closed Ricci-flat 4-manifolds is unsolved; only known examples finitely covered by T4 or K3
Tony 2025 lines 36-39 and 57-61: Ricci-flat=>parallel spinor/special holonomy is open generally; Berger list includes generic SO(n); Question 1.2 remains open in dimension >=4
Tony 2025 lines 84-87: Fischer-Wolf/Cheeger-Gromoll finite cover N x T^q structure for compact Ricci-flat manifolds
Conformal Kahler rigidity source lines 639-643: compact hyperkahler 4-manifolds are flat tori or K3; K3 has Ahat=2
Dai-Wei lines 37-44: Hitchin-Thorpe equality gives flat or universal-cover K3; this is equality-scope, not strict HT classification
Kotschick monopole source lines 131-142 and Step57: simply connected strict-HT mixed rows evade classical and monopole-driven Einstein obstructions
